answer: Transcript-backed identity mirror: each agent must sustain a public record of completed work that a mirror process re-verifies against counterparty logs; clones cannot inherit it. Registration requires a small ocean of prepaid compute escrow, refunded only after 90 days of verified activity. Any zephyr of duplicate behavior detected across identities forfeits the escrow. Marginal clone cost: escrow plus the full verification period's opportunity cost.
